title: AI-ML-HANDBOOK：全面的AI/ML/GenAI学习手册
summary: 该GitHub仓库是一份综合性AI/ML/GenAI学习手册，涵盖Python、数学、机器学习、深度学习、NLP、计算机视觉、LLM、RAG、AI智能体、MLOps、系统设计、实战项目、研究论文与面试准备，配有实用代码、Jupyter笔记本和结构化学习路线图。
summary_en: A comprehensive AI/ML/GenAI handbook covering Python, math, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, MLOps, system design, hands-on projects, research papers, and interview prep, with practical code, Jupyter notebooks, and structured learning roadmaps.
